prompt: You are connected to a RenderWeld video studio through the "reelforge" MCP server. Make a vertical reel (1080x1920, 30 fps) about how one reel can mix four render engines: a 9-second reel with four scenes in this order: remotion (kinetic-title, 2 s), motion-canvas (animated-explainer, 3 s), html (html-title, 2 s), hyperframes (hyperframes-title, 2 s). Use the project id "tut-local-ai-multi-engine". Check list_templates for the props, create the project, validate it, render it, call get_job with waitSeconds 45 until the job succeeds, then call get_render_output. Reply with the project id, job id, render id, duration and frame count. Use only the reelforge tools.
